name: W1 the guard is a no-op — every write path is open again
W2 production no longer refuses to start without a token (silent open mint)
W3 a guessable short token is accepted
W4 401 distinguishes 'no token' from 'wrong token' (tells a prober which half to attack)
from: throw Object.assign(new HttpError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'this path creates authority and requires a bearer token'),
to: throw Object.assign(new HttpError(401, presented ? 'BAD_TOKEN' : 'NO_TOKEN', 'this path creates authority and requires a bearer token'),

name: W5 any auth scheme is accepted, not just Bearer
W6 comparison becomes a prefix match — a one-character token would authenticate
W7 WWW-Authenticate dropped from the 401 (RFC 9110 §11.6.1 requires it)
W8 OVER-BROAD: /authorize gets locked too — an agent can no longer ask permission
from: { method: 'POST', match: exact('/authorize'), handler: makeAuthorizeRoute(store, keystore) },
to: { method: 'POST', match: exact('/authorize'), handler: guardWrites(writePolicy, makeAuthorizeRoute(store, keystore)) },

name: W9 OVER-BROAD: /evidence gets locked — a verifier with no account is the whole product
from: { method: 'GET', match: param('/evidence/', 'id'), handler: makeEvidenceRoute(store, keystore) },
to: { method: 'GET', match: param('/evidence/', 'id'), handler: guardWrites(writePolicy, makeEvidenceRoute(store, keystore)) },
